# A new idea arrives while the discipline's slot holds another.
kehillah_spark.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = kehillah_spark.0002.t
	desc = kehillah_spark.0002.desc
	theme = learning
	left_portrait = { character = root animation = thinking }
	trigger = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form }
	option = {
		name = kehillah_spark.0002.keep
		remove_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form
		remove_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_work
	}
	option = {
		name = kehillah_spark.0002.take
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_spark.0002.take.tt
		hidden_effect = { kehillah_spark_take_pending_effect = yes }
	}
}
